swap_risks: HIGH SWITCHING TIMING SHIFT: Propagation delay differs by 7.2x (TLV3201AIDBVR: 43 ns p.5 vs TLV7011DBVR: 310 ns p.7); verify overcurrent/zero-crossing trip latency and hysteresis timing.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 8x (TLV3201AIDBVR: 40 µA/ch p.5 vs TLV7011DBVR: 5 µA/ch p.7); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 29% higher on TLV7011DBVR (TLV3201AIDBVR: 237.8 °C/W p.4 vs TLV7011DBVR: 306.3 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TLV3201AIDBVR requires Vs,min >= 2.7 V (p.4) vs 1.6 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: TLV3201AIDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV7011DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because comparator propagation delay differs 7.2x; quiescent supply current Iq/ch differs 8x; θJA worsens 29% (thermal derating verification required). Signal-chain deltas: propagation delay 43 ns (p.5) vs 310 ns (p.7), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.4) vs 5.5 V (p.5), Vos 3 mV (p.5) vs 8 mV (p.7), Ib 5x gap (1 vs 5 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TLV3201AIDBVR "Push-Pull Output — Do NOT Wired-AND or Pull Up to a Different Logic Rail" (p.5) and TLV7011DBVR "Push-Pull Output Cannot Be Wired-AND or Pulled Up to a Higher Logic Rail" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TLV3201AIDBVR when DC precision demands <= 3 mV max Vos or fast trip response requires 43 ns propagation delay; choose TLV7011DBVR when ultra-low supply current (5 µA/ch) is prioritized. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
